registry_info.description: A biased random walk as a body, for the Randomness sequence.

random_walk_tubes.name: Random walk tubes
random_walk_tubes.description: A walk toward a goal made of chance, ported from Palle's second Rhino script: from a random start, six steps, each trying five random moves (-1..5 on every axis) and keeping those that end nearer the goal than the step began; every step piped to one middle point with spheres at the ends, and a thick tube along the cubic B-spline the steps steer (rs.AddCurve: start and goal are passed through, the steps are control points). The walk's diagonal runs along +X; scale sets metres per unit, and a walk that climbs taller than fit_height (5.2 m) is scaled down to fit under a storey. Solid. Config: #seed #scale #steps #tries #step_min #step_max #fit_height
